pages.text: By using Skin Boots as a base, with a good number of Blood Feathers and some Ashen Remains, it's possible to create boots that are accompanied by an Ophanim imitation. In practice, this can be seen as a 'blessed' pair of boots, which severely increases the wearer's agility. Though, due to the materials used, the defensive capabilities of the armor are almost non-existent.

Even the enchantability falls quite short. At most, the boots can accept Unbreaking and Mending. Nonetheless, the mobility the Threads Of The Firmament can provide oftentimes outweighs the disadvantages.
